blocks.tamil_translation: if, on seeing the hardship sent from My side, he praises Me (with patience), (I command the angels) “Just as you used to write the reward for the deeds he did while he was healthy, write the good of all those deeds exactly so” — Hazrat Shaddad ibn Aws (RA) narrates this Hadith Qudsi, which the Prophet ﷺ related as the saying of Allah Ta'ala.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَاَ يَزَالُ الْمَلِيلَةُ وَالصُّدَاعُ بِالْعَبْدِ وَالأَمَةِ وَإِنْ عَلَيْهِمَا مِنَ الْخَطَايَا مِثْلَ أُحُدٍ، فَمَا يَدَعُهُمَا وَعَلَيْهِمَا مِثْقَالُ خَرْدَلَةٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو يعلي ورجاله ثقات مجمع الزوائد :٣ /٢٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “If any believing man or woman has a lasting inner fever or a headache, it will not leave even a mustard seed's worth of his sins, even if his sins are as much as the mountain of Uhud!” — Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِنِ الْخُدْرِيِّ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: صُدَاعُ الْمُؤْمِنِ وَشَوْكَةٌ يُشَاكُهَا أَوْ شَيْءٌ يُؤْذِيهِ يَرْفَعُهُ اللهُ بِهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ دَرَجَةً، وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنْهُ بِهَا ذُنُوبَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ابي الدنيا ورواته ثقات الترغيب:٤ /٢٩٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “If a believer suffers a headache, or the prick of a thorn, or any other hardship, because of it Allah Ta'ala raises that believer by one rank on the Day of Qiyamah, and because of that hardship his sins are forgiven” — Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.
